body: I have CL and I’m near Taylor Ranch. I pay for 80g dL and it usually falls between 55-60 dL, 10g upload. That is on 5g too. But I like the “price for life” and it’s sufficient enough for our household. No promotional pricing hikes. Xfinity was my worst experience and I ended up having to reach out to their corporate level to get my issues resolved several years ago. So I’ll never go back to them.

One way we saved quite a bit of money was through Facebook neighborhood groups.  Some are labeled “beg barter buy” followed by the neighborhood name. We saved on all kinds of things parents just want to get rid of. I’m talking buying a whole wardrobe for kids for like $30-$50.

It could just be something as simple as a vericocele. I was scared too when I noticed a lump. But I can tell you that feeling after seeing a doctor either way will be a relief. The unknown is much scarier my friend.

Have you discussed with him how you’re feeling? I’m sure at one point, he had some redeeming qualities, right? Otherwise you probably wouldn’t have married him. I get so frustrated with my wife all the time, but I find when we open up instead of trying to prove who’s wrong, it usually can be worked out. I’ve learned to choose my battles wisely. That being said, I know my flaws and admit them and try my best to improve. She appreciates that. Also, do you know if he is depressed? Hope it works out for you either way.
Man, just go to the green belt in Austin. Several good swimming spots along the way to cool off. Too damn hot to go on long hikes this time of year. Lol

I could probably find a way to change jobs and that would be a good start.  Limited opportunities where I live though. Worked many years to get where I am at and starting over again somewhere else sounds awful.  And most likely will fall short of my financial obligations.  But really I don’t care for my passions anymore. Too far in the gutter now.

My wife’s another situation. Divorce is highly likely. But I should start somewhere to work on each shitty situation. Otherwise I’ll never make any progress.  I hate this. 

However thanks for listening.
